architectureDecisions: D1 — Union helper seam: add pure scripts/blackboard-verification-bundle.mjs exporting bundleRefs(result), buildBundle(result, loadBody) and installBundle(root, id, bundle). bundleRefs returns the deterministically sorted dedupe of verificationRuns.logRef plus claims.evidenceRefs (negativeCases logRefs are already run refs); buildBundle pairs each ref with its exact body bytes in that order; installBundle validates safe refs and digests before any write or provider call. No I/O inside bundleRefs; loadBody and filesystem access are injected by callers.

D2 — CI collect seam: replace the claim-only enumeration in scripts/blackboard-jev-ci.mjs collect with bundleRefs/buildBundle. The uploaded bundle keeps the exact {result, files} shape with files in bundleRefs order and byte-identical bodies. No new bundle fields, no provider key in the collect job, and no change to any worker verification mapping.

D3 — CI evaluate and delivery import seam: evaluate restores files through installBundle, then writes bundle.result to the evidence ref and calls materialize, so a missing log fails as ENOENT-free fail-closed before any provider call. importEvaluationEvidence delegates its union enumeration to bundleRefs with byte-identical behavior; BB-059/079/084 mappings are preserved and never edited.

D4 — Fail-closed rules: a missing entry for a union ref, a body whose hash differs from its bound run.logHash, a ref outside docs/blackboard/evidence/<WORK_ID>/ or with an unsafe basename, or an empty body for a non-empty bound hash all throw before any provider call and before writing partial evidence. Duplicate refs are deduped to one file; order is normalized to bundleRefs sort so bytes and digests are deterministic.

D5 — Separation regression fixtures: new test/blackboard-verification-bundle.test.mjs replays the real BB-059 CI36805700271 shape (eight verificationRuns including one passing run referenced by no claim, seven claim-linked files, one retained observation log) through separated build/install/materialize steps with mock transport asserting zero provider calls on invalid input.

D6 — Wiring and binding policy: the new test file is the only expectedTest; no package.json standing-script or workflow edit is required, so existing worker plans keep their mappings. negativeCaseBindings are mandatory (BB-134 is above the jev-policy.json negativeCaseBindingsFromWorkId BB-100 threshold) with one distinct BUNDLE-FAILCLOSED test title per negativeVerificationCases index invoking installBundle or buildBundle with a real assertion.

D7 — Delivery and rollback boundary: worker writes are limited to scripts/blackboard-jev-ci.mjs, scripts/blackboard-verification-bundle.mjs, test/blackboard-verification-bundle.test.mjs and docs/living/system/state.md. Graph, state, contexts, objectives, readiness, receipts and CI workflows are untouched; rollback reverts only those four paths.
implementationSlices: B1 — Union helper plus CI collect/evaluate seams [COMPLETE, FAILCLOSED]: implement bundleRefs/buildBundle/installBundle per D1, rewire collect per D2 and evaluate per D3, keeping the {result, files} shape and credential separation. Tests titled BUNDLE-UNION prove exact bytes, deterministic order, duplicate dedupe and digest equality against the BB-059 eight-run shape.

B2 — Separation regression [SEPARATION]: implement the BUNDLE-SEPARATION fixture per D5 with one passing verification run referenced by no acceptance claim plus a retained observation log; prove separated build/install/materialize succeeds, all union logs are present, and transport alone grants no acceptance (bindings and verdict rules unchanged).

B3 — Fail-closed negatives plus bindings [FAILCLOSED]: implement the four BUNDLE-FAILCLOSED cases per D4, each bound to a distinct test title invoking installBundle or buildBundle with a non-vacuous assertion; invalid input throws before any provider call (mock fetch asserts zero calls) and writes no partial evidence.

B4 — Living Docs plus full verification [DOCS]: document the trusted bundle behavior in docs/living/system/state.md without changing judgment authority, then run bundle-union, bundle-separation, bundle-failclosed, verify:blackboard-context and full npm run verify; real independent readiness/candidate gates complete delivery outside this plan.

negativeVerificationCases: A bundle that omits a union verification log (a run referenced by no acceptance claim) fails closed before any provider call.

A bundle entry with an empty body for a bound non-empty log hash fails closed without a provider call.
